persons.name: Bhīma
persons.evidence: likṣita palikṣiḥta śrīmānīgla pūrṅvgata śrīyoyakoche devajña bhīmayā juro

relations.evidence: palikṣiḥta śrīmānīgla pūrṅvgata śrīyoyakoche devajña bhīmayā juro || śrīsohalanihmaṃ dvijavara śrīpadumadeva jula svapvastakaṃ

date.as_written: samvata 595 caitra śukla || tṛtīyāyāṃ tithau || aśvininakṣetre śukravāsare

notes: Mānīgla is modern Patan (Yala). 'palikṣiḥta ... bhīmayā juro' indicates Daivajña Bhīma copied the manuscript, and 'padumadeva jula svapvastakaṃ' indicates it became the personal copy (svapustaka) of Dvijavara Padmadeva.
